title: About half of Americans say they spend too much time on their smartphone
summary_en: Seven-in-ten adults under 30 say they spend too much time on their smartphone, as do about two-thirds of those ages 30 to 49.
title_cn: About half of Americans say they spend too much time on their smartphone

title: Latinos Are Split on Whether the American Dream Is Achievable
summary_en: Far more Latinos say their standard of living is better than their parents’ (57%), rather than worse (23%). More also say their children’s standard of living will be better than their own (53%) as opposed to worse (14%).
title_cn: Latinos Are Split on Whether the American Dream Is Achievable
